name: Dictator
introduce:
LTX-219 裁决者
由拉尼亚凯亚研发的中型战术机兵。是日弩-朝阳研发线上推出的新型机兵。
LTX-219继承了日弩系战术机兵与朝阳系工程机兵的双重优势。其核心织火者芯片能根据战局战况，实时协调战术武器的发射策略和打击方式。尤其在弹药装填与打击面方面，相比前代机型有了质变般的提升。而迭代自日弩的行进驱动装置L1102-X，则能让裁决者在运动战中获得更佳稳定的发射条件，将战场移动对打击精度的干扰降低到最低。

20474.name: Fireweaver Mod
20474.SpecificEffects: Increases DMG by <color=#F74848>15%</color> when attacking with tactical weapons. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> round of ammo in the magazine, further increases DMG by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>35%</color>.

30368.name: Bombing Mod
30368.SpecificEffects:
When using Code skills to attack, DMG increases by <color=#F74848>18%</color>.
When actively attacking with tactical weapons, if <color=#F74848>3</color> or more targets are hit, randomly reload <color=#F74848>1</color> ammo of tactical weapon. Can be activated <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.
